crossrefs.text: Husbands, in the same way, treat your wives with consideration as a delicate vessel, and with honor as fellow heirs of the gracious gift of life, so that your prayers will not be hindered.
In the same way, husbands ought to love their wives as their own bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.
Nevertheless, each one of you also must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.
But if they cannot control themselves, let them marry. For it is better to marry than to burn with passion.
May your fountain be blessed, and may you rejoice in the wife of your youth:
A loving doe, a graceful fawn— may her breasts satisfy you always; may you be captivated by her love forever.
He who finds a wife finds a good thing and obtains favor from the LORD.
“Not everyone can accept this word,” He replied, “but only those to whom it has been given.
But because there is so much sexual immorality, each man should have his own wife, and each woman her own husband.
So I advise the younger widows to marry, have children, and manage their households, denying the adversary occasion for slander.
But refuse to enroll younger widows. For when their passions draw them away from Christ, they will want to marry,
I want you to be free from concern. The unmarried man is concerned about the work of the Lord, how he can please the Lord.
Because of the present crisis, I think it is good for a man to remain as he is. Are you committed to a wife? Do not seek to be released. Are you free of commitment? Do not look for a wife.
But if you do marry, you have not sinned. And if a virgin marries, she has not sinned. But those who marry will face troubles in this life, and I want to spare you this.

and his interests are divided. The unmarried woman or virgin is concerned about the work of the Lord, how she can be holy in both body and spirit. But the married woman is concerned about the affairs of this world, how she can please her husband. I am saying this for your own good, not to restrict you, but in order to promote proper decorum and undivided devotion to the Lord.

However, if someone thinks he is acting inappropriately toward his betrothed, and if she is beyond her youth and they ought to marry, let him do as he wishes; he is not sinning; they should get married.
But I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, brings adultery upon her. And he who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.
Has not the LORD made them one, having a portion of the Spirit? And why one? Because He seeks godly offspring. So guard yourselves in your spirit and do not break faith with the wife of your youth.
“For I hate divorce,” says the LORD, the God of Israel. “He who divorces his wife covers his garment with violence,” says the LORD of Hosts. So guard yourselves in your spirit and do not break faith.
Anyone who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery, and he who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.
So then, let us pursue what leads to peace and to mutual edification.
Yet you ask, “Why?” It is because the LORD has been a witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have broken faith, though she is your companion and your wife by covenant.
“For I hate divorce,” says the LORD, the God of Israel. “He who divorces his wife covers his garment with violence,” says the LORD of Hosts. So guard yourselves in your spirit and do not break faith.
Then some Pharisees came and tested Him by asking, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”
you were bought at a price. Therefore glorify God with your body.
For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life you inherited from your forefathers,
but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or spot.
Because the Israelites are My servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt, they are not to be sold as slaves.
He gave Himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and to purify for Himself a people for His own possession, zealous for good deeds.
That is why I have sent you Timothy, my beloved and faithful child in the Lord. He will remind you of my way of life in Christ Jesus, which is exactly what I teach everywhere in every church.
For neither circumcision nor uncircumcision means anything. What counts is a new creation.
Live in freedom, but do not use your freedom as a cover-up for evil; live as servants of God.
The world is passing away, along with its desires; but whoever does the will of God remains forever.
Husbands, in the same way, treat your wives with consideration as a delicate vessel, and with honor as fellow heirs of the gracious gift of life, so that your prayers will not be hindered.
Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat or drink; or about your body, what you will wear. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothes?
Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Today has enough trouble of its own.
The end of all things is near. Therefore be clear-minded and sober, so that you can pray.

However, if someone thinks he is acting inappropriately toward his betrothed, and if she is beyond her youth and they ought to marry, let him do as he wishes; he is not sinning; they should get married.
The widow who is truly in need and left all alone puts her hope in God and continues night and day in her petitions and prayers.
The world is passing away, along with its desires; but whoever does the will of God remains forever.
For instance, a married woman is bound by law to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is released from the law of marriage.

So then, if she is joined to another man while her husband is still alive, she is called an adulteress; but if her husband dies, she is free from that law and is not an adulteress, even if she marries another man.
Do not be unequally yoked with unbelievers. For what partnership can righteousness have with wickedness? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?

What agreement can exist between the temple of God and idols? For we are the temple of the living God. As God has said: “I will dwell with them and walk among them, and I will be their God, and they will be My people.”
To the married I give this command (not I, but the Lord): A wife must not separate from her husband.
Marriage should be honored by all and the marriage bed kept undefiled, for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
the sons of God saw that the daughters of men were beautiful, and they took as wives whomever they chose.

Do not intermarry with them. Do not give your daughters to their sons or take their daughters for your sons, because they will turn your sons away from following Me to serve other gods. Then the anger of the LORD will burn against you, and He will swiftly destroy you.
